settings.heading: Privacy Policy
settings.body: Do not publish a generic template. Complete this policy for your final app stack, ad pixels, analytics tools, markets, legal entity, and contact address before launch.

settings.content:
Draft outline — required sections to complete:

  • Identity and contact details of the business
  • Information collected directly, automatically, and from Shopify / service providers
  • Order, payment, account, device, analytics, marketing, and customer-support data
  • Quiz answers, and the rule that sensitive health information is not requested unless legally reviewed
  • Purposes and legal bases where applicable
  • Cookies, analytics, advertising pixels, and consent controls
  • Sharing with Shopify, payment providers, fulfillment, email, reviews, chat, analytics, and advertising partners
  • International transfers and retention periods
  • Customer rights by jurisdiction
  • Children’s privacy and minimum purchase age
  • Security statement without absolute guarantees
  • Policy changes and contact method
